subject.title: feat(feishu): native Markdown for inbound content_v2 & outbound tag:md

question: Should Feishu native `tag:md` posts replace the existing automatic card and table-conversion behavior for upgraded users, or remain an explicit opt-in path?
rationale: Both transports are supported, but choosing the default changes shipped rendering semantics and makes an accepted configuration preference inert; source inspection cannot determine the intended long-term product policy.

options.title: Split and preserve defaults
options.body: Land the inbound `content_v2` work separately and retain current outbound `auto` and table-mode behavior until a focused policy change is approved.

options.title: Approve native-post default
options.body: Intentionally switch upgraded users to native posts, then document the compatibility change and prove fresh-install, upgrade, streaming, and non-streaming behavior.

options.title: Keep native posts opt-in
options.body: Use the existing explicit raw/non-streaming configuration path or a narrowly approved mode without changing current automatic routing.

recommendation.title: Split and preserve defaults
recommendation.body: Land the inbound `content_v2` work separately and retain current outbound `auto` and table-mode behavior until a focused policy change is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the current outbound `auto` routing policy, making them the strongest available history-based routing candidate for this decision.
